notes.title: Regular Update #6 - 🎄Christmas Season🎄
notes.notes:
[h1]🎄Christmas Season🎄[/h1]

[i]The snow is falling, the bells are ringing and HIGhSCORE is brimming with holiday cheer! With the end of the Halloween season, it’s time to celebrate the Christmas season in style. The Hub is blanketed in snow, there’s a sweet new companion to join your runs and festive surprises await. Check out what’s new below![/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Winter Wonderland Hub[/b] - The Hub has been transformed into a cozy winter wonderland! Enjoy sparkling Christmas decorations, falling snow and the warm glow of holiday lights!
[*] [b]Gingerbread Companion[/b] - Say goodbye to the bat and hello to the Gingerbread Companion! This cheerful cookie helper will join you in your runs, automatically collecting Coins, Orbs, Combo Items and Keys. It’s the perfect teammate for the holiday season!
[*] [b]Seasonal Collectibles[/b] - Scattered throughout the Hub, festive presents can now be found, offering rewards of 250–500 coins each. Keep your eyes peeled for these holiday gifts!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/7b25e85cb8e4a75b4b6883b726e60e0e5862699a.png[/img]

[h1]🦉Shared Wisdom🦉[/h1]

[i]"The sweetest victories are shared with friends... and cookies."[/i] - Sir Elo the Wise

[h1]📝Developer Message📝[/h1]

[i]As the year comes to a close, I want to take a moment to thank each and every one of you who has given HIGhSCORE a chance. Whether you’ve spent hours chasing high scores, shared your feedback or simply enjoyed a quick run, your support means the world to me.

Every player, every name on the leaderboard and every review brings me immense joy and motivation to keep improving the game. This Christmas update is my way of saying thank you and spreading a little holiday cheer.

I hope you enjoy this festive season in HIGhSCORE and I wish you all a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year![/i]🎄

notes.title: Regular Update #5 - 🎃Halloween Season🎃
notes.notes:
[h1]🎃Halloween Season🎃[/h1]

[i]Welcome to Halloween Season in HIGhSCORE! I may have started with just a sprinkle of spookiness, but things got a little out of hand (in the best way). Now the Hub’s haunted, there’s a bat buddy flying around, and pumpkins are practically paying you to play. Check out what’s new below![/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Hub Makeover[/b] - The Hub area has been transformed with eerie Halloween decor! Step in and experience the spooky vibes!
[*] [b]Pumpkin Collectables[/b] - Scattered around the Hub, you’ll find collectible pumpkins granting between 250-500 coins each. Don’t miss out on these spooky rewards!
[*] [b]Bat Companion[/b] - During the Halloween season, a helpful Bat Companion will join you in your runs. This winged ally will automatically collect Coins, Orbs, Combo Items and Keys so you can focus entirely on survival. After the season, the bat will fly away, but watch out for future companions with unique abilities in the [i][b]next major update[/b][/i]!
[*] [b]New Halloween Stage[/b] - A chilling new Halloween-themed stage awaits! With a nightmarish setting, this stage will become a permanent addition to HIGhSCORE!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/68139053d08c2d56a9977ca87ab7dee1eca2c9e0.png[/img]
    
[h1]🎩New Hats🎩[/h1]

[i]Add these creepy hats to your collection![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/f3e0415b9fb0193cfb8264c5eb18e474415ab5d5.png[/img]

[h1]🎨New Colors🎨[/h1]

[i]Unlock a unique color scheme to bring the Halloween vibe into your runs![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/14aa115bba95393e5a4cb77938bd5e6ed5d9c725.png[/img]

[h1]🛠 Bugfixes & Improvements 🛠[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Button Animations[/b] - All buttons now have a subtle animation to enhance responsiveness and menu flow, making navigation feel smoother.
[*] [b]Tooltip Revamp[/b] - The tooltip system has been revamped for a cleaner and more consistent look across all inspectable buttons.
[*] [b]Skill Tree Icons[/b] - Certain icons in the Skill Tree have been redesigned to provide clearer visuals and improve the overall UI consistency.
[*] [b]Jump in Style[/b] - A new jump animation has been added to bring a bit more variety to your aerial moves! Now every leap has a little extra flair—perfect for showing off while dodging danger.
[*] [b]Player Stats Resized[/b] - To improve readability, player stats in the Hub's and Game's Pause Menu have been resized, with reorganized buttons to create a more streamlined layout.
[*] [b]Portal Shader Update[/b] - The portal visuals have been upgraded with a more realistic shader while maintaining the game’s art style.
[*] [b]Buttons[/b] - All frame buttons have been replaced with blank buttons to create a cleaner, more interactive UI across menus.
[*] [b]Splash Text[/b] - A randomly generated splash text now appears in the Main Menu and Run Summary, providing funny, motivating messages each time you load up or finish a run.
[*] [b]Hall of Fame Placeholders[/b] - Entries in the Hall of Fame now feature placeholders, giving a more structured and organized look to the leaderboard.
[*] [b]Local Leaderboard Bug Fix[/b] - A bug that caused only the first entry to display in the Local Leaderboards has been squashed. Now, all scores are visible!
[/list]
[h1]🦉Shared Wisdom🦉[/h1]

[i]"You can’t win HIGhSCORE in a minute. But you can lose it."[/i] - Sir Elo the Wise

[h1]📝Developer Message📝[/h1]

[i]I hope you’re all excited about the update! Originally, I just wanted to release a small Halloween patch, but it turned into something a bit bigger in the end. 

Huge thanks to every HIGhSCORE player out there, relentlessly chasing those high scores - seeing new names on the leaderboards always brings me endless joy!

If you’re enjoying the new features, I’d love to hear your feedback through a review or a post on the community page. Your ideas keep me inspired to keep adding more fun. Wishing you all an amazing Halloween season and tons of fun in HIGhSCORE!🎃[/i]

notes.title: Regular Update #4 - Player Stats & Xmas Event
notes.notes:
[h1]Christmas Season[/h1]

[list]
[*] Embrace the holiday spirit with festive changes! 
[*] The Hub area is adorned with blinking lights and snowfall adds to the ambiance
[*] Explore the Hub area to discover Christmas presents granting 250-500 coins, accelerating early game progression
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/1fe06f9e53642907b47ea04b978d8cc84d40d6f5.png[/img]

[h1]Player Stats[/h1]

[list]
[*] Accessible by pressing ESC in the Hub area or during gameplay
[*] The menu showcases parameters subject to modification via items, auras, passive points, etc.
[*] All stats are colored white by default and turn green when modified for better visibility
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/ceda813250a29210892dce987992a05a57d9421b.png[/img]

[h1]Hats[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/12b2f8dc2202133d29f8219ac2c699609a1f6019.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes/Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Exp Aura now grants double experience, effectively doubling any experience bonus applied (e.g., 1000% becomes 2000%)
[*] Optimized camera speed increase calculation, capping at -95%. This ensures a more accurate camera speed increase rate accounting for various bonuses and traits.
[*] Refined experience increase and combobar decrease calculations to eliminate rounding errors
[*] Enhanced level display visuals in the hub and during level up animations for a more appealing design
[*] Resolved an issue where a positive bonus stage was less frequent than a negative one. Now, players have a 60% chance of encountering a positive bonus stage and a 40% chance of facing a negative one 
[*] Implemented visibility for used items/runes when a runic conflux is created. The utilized items/runes are now displayed in the top-left corner in the hub 
[*] Fixed a bug causing the tooltip to momentarily appear at the wrong location. The tooltip now immediately displays at the correct position
[/list]

[h1]Developer Message[/h1]

[i]I hope you enjoy this update! Originally planned as a hotfix, it evolved into an event patch with the addition of player stats. 

Wishing everyone a joyful and merry gaming experience. Have a blast pursuing the HIGhSCORE![/i]

notes.title: Major Update #1
notes.notes:
[i]I'm thrilled to introduce the biggest update for HIGhSCORE since its release. Get ready for exciting new features and improvements![/i]

[h1]Introducing Sozzy the Sorcerer[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/252565e632681ba1e1233caa22bc4667b4b2ce8e.png[/img]
Meet Sozzy the Sorcerer, a new NPC in the game, located in his own dedicated area within the hub. Sozzy's Crafting Table allows players to modify runes in three different ways:

[h2]Combine[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/a674e3afc85c07103168646239ab42fa22dc081f.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Combine three green or blue runes to create a new rune
[*]Combining green runes may yield a blue or even a rare purple rune
[*]Combining blue runes may result in a purple rune
[*]The cost of combining is based on the rune's base price
[*]The resulting rune is added to your collection for future use
[/list]

[h2]Split[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/89f968096824a8d77bbfb9fe165b61f86840539d.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Split blue or purple runes to obtain two to four new runes of a lower rarity
[*]Splitting blue runes can yield up to four green runes
[*] The cost of splitting is determined by the rune's base price
[*]The obtained runes are added to your collection for future use
[/list]

[h2]Fuse[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/8578863031ed72de0bdb9a0867ee2bfe9cd59432.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]The game-changing feature![/b] Fuse three runes to create a legendary item called [b]Runic Conflux[/b] with combined effects
[*]The Runic Conflux is immediately available in your inventory for the next run
[*]The cost of fusing is based on the rune's base price
[*]You can still select three runes before each run even with a Runic Conflux, but only one Runic Conflux can be active at a time
[*]The Runic Conflux allows for incredible combinations that can skyrocket your score like never before
[/list]

[h1]Other Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*]A complete overhaul of the user interface, making it easier to navigate between options like Skills, Passives, Items, Achievements, and Medals
[*]Right-click to reset points in the Skill and Passive trees
[*]Visual improvements for Sir Elo the Wise's Rune Selection, inventory items, achievements, and medals
[*]New indicators for unlocked game elements and red points to guide players
[/list]

[h1]New Bonus Stage[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/4f532ab27df29962d8e25479ada838cd685683ee.png[/img]
Added a new red Bonus Stage, which shrinks the player to half the size for 10 seconds.


[h1]New Hats[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573410/af9471c9274791aa34c0f48cf0f5e206e15dc802.png[/img]


[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where drops from destroyed wooden crates were not immediately collected
[*]Fixed an issue where luck would not affect the rarity of item drops in runs
[*]Fixed an issue where the passive skill "Stage Distance" would affect the transition between stages negatively
[/list]

[h1]Developer Message[/h1]

[i]I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to all players who have been a part of the HIGhSCORE journey. It fills me with immense happiness to see my creation bring joy to others. I greatly value your feedback and am committed to enhancing the player experience for both new and existing players. 

Thank you for keeping the game alive and thriving. 

Enjoy the update![/i]

notes.title: Regular Update #3 - Easter Weekend
notes.notes:
[h1]Events[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Easter Weekend[/b]: The game now has an Easter theme till 04/10/2023. 

[i]"Look closely for some Easter eggs and maybe you will be rewarded with some extra coins"[/i] - Sir Elo the Wise
[/list]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]In the [b]Hall of Fame[/b], the player can now toggle between 'All' and 'Best' runs per player for each online leaderboard type (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, All Time)
[*]The leaderboard rows in the [b]Defeat Screen[/b] now display the player's current top ranking for each online leaderboard with the best score. If the own score is beaten or a new score set, the player will be rewarded with an appropriate medal
[*]Added the [b]MAX Combo[/b] count to the statistics. Note that every run prior to this update will have a [b]MAX Combo[/b] value of 'x0'
[/list]
[h1]Hats[/h1]
[list]
[*]Easter
[*]pRac Cap
[*]Antlers
[/list]
[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Chrono Belt[/b]: -1s Hourglass Time
[*][b]Eternity Cape[/b]: -3s Hourglass Time
[*][b]Time-Turner Necklace[/b]: -5s Hourglass Time
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a pop up to indicate when the [b]Camera Speed[/b] is increased
[*]The [b]Hourglass[/b] now works independently from the [b]Camera Speed[/b]. The [b]Hourglass Multiplier[/b] increases every 30 - (item bonus) seconds, while the [b]Camera Speed[/b] increases every 30 seconds
[*]The maximum required [b]Orb[/b] count has been decreased from 10 to 7
[*]Enchanted Ring now increases the [b]Orb[/b] value by 2 instead of 3
[*]Crystal Ball now increases the [b]Orb[/b] value by 3 instead of 5
[*]In the [b]Aura Selection[/b] after pressing 'Retry' after a run, there is now a small note that the player can proceed without buying anything
[*]When the [b]Combo Bonus Stage[/b] is active, [b]Combo Shards[/b] are now spawned
[*]When a combo ends, the resulting points are now styled in the same way as the score to make it easier for the player to understand how many points they got
[*]A bug has been fixed where the score popup text would not be displayed correctly when the score is too high
[/list]
